trailhead.label: The chapel of Santa Caterina d’Alessandria at Cella (Villapiccola), by Lake Santa Caterina, the board’s start

cautions: The steep mule track up from path 17 to Namos: take it slowly with an older or less fit dog, and carefully on the way down.
Private mountain huts and their meadows at Namos: keep your dog on the path and close.
Forest track open to forestry vehicles in places: keep your dog close if one comes.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Santa Caterina to Pian de Namos: Da Santa Caterina a Pian de Namos, andata e ritorno
textIt.The chapel of Santa Caterina d’Alessandr: La chiesetta di Santa Caterina d’Alessandria a Cella (Villapiccola), vicino al lago di Santa Caterina, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.The steep mule track up from path 17 to: La ripida mulattiera che dal sentiero 17 sale a Namos: procedete con calma con un cane anziano o poco allenato, e con attenzione in discesa.
textIt.Private mountain huts and their meadows: Baite private e i loro prati a Namos: tenete il cane sul sentiero e vicino a voi.
textIt.Forest track open to forestry vehicles i: Strada forestale aperta in alcuni tratti ai mezzi forestali: tenete il cane vicino se ne arriva uno.
